planName: Order Service Java 25 and Spring Boot 4 Modernization

entries.taskSummary: Snapshotted 'app/Java - Spring Boot/Order Service' to an isolated temp folder and built the frozen baseline exclusively from that snapshot, independent of any in-flight migration/upgrade tasks. Ran the full backend suite (mvn test) from the snapshot: BUILD SUCCESS, Tests run 20 / Failures 0 / Errors 0 / Skipped 0 across OrderRepositoryTest, OrderServiceTest, OrderServiceUnitTest, and OrderControllerTest. Ran the frontend suite/build from the snapshot: npm test (node --test) 4/4 passed; npm run build succeeded (36 modules transformed). Authored src/test/test-cases/test-cases.md documenting the Order API contract, validation rules, H2 persistence assumptions, CORS/web config, the full backend test inventory, the frontend view-logic contract, and a frozen infra-decision table selecting MOCKED external dependencies for every dependency (H2 kept embedded/in-process; no Azure resource, credential, or connection referenced anywhere, per the no-provisioned-Azure-environment constraint). Added testdata/seeded-orders.json, testdata/sample-requests.json, and testdata/frontend-orders-fixture.json as frozen fixtures. Copied only these frozen artifacts back into the live workspace under src/test/test-cases/ (production source untouched) and committed them on the current branch. The folder is now FROZEN.
risks: The frozen baseline was captured against the pre-upgrade Java 8 / Spring Boot 2.7.18 source snapshot; if the Java 25 / Spring Boot 4 upgrade (task 001) changes observable behavior beyond the frozen contract (e.g. validation error format, enum bind error status), Phase 3 PostMigrationIT tests will surface it as a regression requiring an explicit unfreeze/re-freeze cycle rather than a silent fix.

No provisioned Azure environment exists for this plan; the infra-decision table freezes every external dependency to a MOCKED/embedded strategy (H2 in-memory), so this baseline cannot detect regressions specific to a real Azure-hosted database or service.
followUps: When Phase 3 (integrationTest) runs, verify all *PostMigrationIT scenarios against the frozen test-cases.md using only mocked/embedded substitutes, with no Azure credentials required.

If a future plan provisions real Azure resources, re-run setupBaseline's re-freeze cycle to update the infra-decision table from MOCKED to a live-resource strategy before relying on it for verification.
